headline: Reserve Bank of India Holds Overnight Variable Rate Repo Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India held an overnight variable rate repo auction with a notified amount of ₹75,000 crore, receiving bids totaling ₹1,40,535 crore.
why: Variable rate repo auctions are liquidity management tools used by central banks to absorb or inject funds into the banking system, influencing short-term interest rates.
